name: io.github.flow-steward/hindsight
title: Hindsight
description: Store, recall and reflect on long-term memories in a Hindsight Cloud memory bank across agent sessions. Requires a Hindsight Cloud API key and available credits.

bank_id.description: Your Hindsight memory bank ID from the Cloud Connect page. Use letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Hindsight Cloud API key from the Connect page. Enter as: Bearer <API key>
